description: Look up a named colour and return its hex, archive, provenance, and cultural notes.

name.description: Colour name e.g. 'Prussian Blue' or 'Ottoman Carbon Ink'

slug.description: Stable colour slug from archive_search e.g. 'keats:keats-s-lung' -- preferred over name for reliable retrieval

name: colour_card

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Get Colour Details by Name
